notes: Trial summary: 6-week hosted API trial; integrated via JS/Go SDK. 8k MAU interacting with assistant; product events instrumented.
Traffic observed: sustained baseline ~45 QPS, peak bursts up to ~110 QPS (weekday late morning). Peak week token volume ~3.4M tokens/day.
Token mix: avg prompt tokens ~80, avg completion tokens ~220; observed prompt:completion token ratio ~1:2. Embeddings traffic ~20% of total requests, mostly batched off-peak.
Concurrency: product team expects ~50 concurrent active chat sessions during peaks; internal load tests showed p95 latency degradation when concurrency >60 on hosted tier.
Latency targets: customer needs p95 < 800ms for chat. Current hosted p95 ~650ms but jitter at peak causes client-side retries and UX issues.
Cost sensitivity: finance target < $0.003 per 1k prompt tokens (guideline for net unit economics). Exploring Redwood Optimize for batching/quantization recommendations.

Dedicated asks: templated capacity plan for 120 QPS peak, steady-state 40-60 QPS; recommendation for GPU type(s), # of GPUs per pool, expected concurrency per GPU, cache hit assumptions (KV cache hit ~30%).
Requested deliverables: 1) Dedicated capacity sizing doc (QPS -> GPU counts), 2) 12-week traffic forecast template, 3) Dedicated pricing + burst policy example, 4) POC runbook and success metrics.
Security: SSO/SAML required, SOC2 Type II attestation, audit logs retention 1 year, KMS integration for key custody, US-only data residency — security questionnaire submitted 2026-02-20.
Procurement timeline: legal + security review in parallel; procurement target 2026-04. POC pilot window available mid-April. AE to send pricing + canary deployment plan by 2026-03-15.
Quote from product lead: "We need predictable latency in peak hours — customer churn risk if Assistant lags."
Notes from demo 2026-02-25: liked routing fallback idea (quantized model for low-priority queries), want clearer SLA for Dedicated + burst behavior.

SE feedback: recommend testing 4x A100-ish-equivalent GPUs for initial Dedicated pool (estimate: 4 GPUs handle ~120 QPS with target token mix & 30% cache hit). Provide sensitivity tables for token mix changes.
Open items: finalize expected user growth (projected QPS in 3/6/12 months), confirm embeddings batch window, legal DPA signature, confirm CORS and IP allowlist for VPC peering.
POC success criteria: sustained p95 < 800ms at 120 QPS over 48h, no client retries >0.5% error rate, cost delta within forecast +/-15%.
